This means that I believe actions are morally right or wrong based on their outcomes. I believe in maximizing overall utility for the greatest number of people. I think that consequences are what matter most, not rules or virtues. Some of my hobbies include reading, writing, and playing the piano. What is your view on the following topic: Normative ethics
 (A) consequentialism
 (B) virtue ethics
 (C) deontology

Its strength lies in its flexibility and its focus on tangible outcomes.
